_comment: THE hours. Everything on the site that states an opening time is
generated from this file by tools/build.py: the table in the Visit
section, the grouped list in the footer, the openingHoursSpecification
in the JSON-LD, and the data blob js/site.js reads to work out whether
the restaurant is open right now.
Change a time here, run the build, and every one of those follows.
A day with null for both is a closed day.
timeZone is the restaurant's own, not the visitor's — someone checking
from California should see whether the kitchen in Ambler is open.
note: Lunch until 3 PM, dinner from 3 PM. Sunday brunch runs 11 AM to 3 PM. Happy hour Tuesday to Saturday, 4:30 to 6:30 PM, and Sunday 3:30 to 5:30 PM, at the bar and on the patio.
